objective: Independent historical methodology screen of the 2026 prior-US-return x Japanese intraday-path hypothesis before true OSE/JNU confirmation.

evidence_anchor.paper: Yasuhiro Iwanaga (2026), How the prior day's S&P 500 returns influence the intraday returns of Nikkei 225 futures

sources.raw_policy: Pinned upstream + Actions cache; private repo stores derived daily path panel/provenance only.

time_handling.predictor_availability: For each Japan open, use the most recent fully completed U.S. cash session strictly before that Japan open.

fixed_targets.FIRST_30M: Japan cash session 09:00 to 09:30 local, log(last/first)
fixed_targets.LAST_30M: Final 30 minutes before the historically valid Japan cash close, log(last/first)

pass_gate.family_rule: FIRST_30M and LAST_30M are one preregistered family; no window-length search.

forbidden: Swap SPX to NQ after results
Add technical indicators to rescue a failure
Interpret proxy pass as JNU validation
Treat same-day U.S. session as available before Japan open
promotion: PROXY_METHOD_SCREEN_ONLY; true OSE/JNU intraday data required for any framework admission.
